title: carex novae-angliae var. rossii
intro: Carex novae-angliae var. rossii, commonly known as New England sedge or Ross's sedge, is a type of grass-like perennial plant belonging to the family Cyperaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its reported health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Carex novae-angliae var. rossii include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which help in relieving symptoms of colds, bronchitis, and other respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
